% LabHarness document style.
%
% v0.1: one typeface for the whole document -- text and every figure -- namely the LaTeX
% default (Computer Modern, through its Latin Modern digitisation). Figures generated by
% LabHarness use the same typeface, so there is a single place to change it.
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{graphicx}

% \labfigure{path}: include a generated figure at its natural (final) size.
% If the figure does not exist yet, show a placeholder so the document still compiles.
\newcommand{\labfigure}[1]{%
  \IfFileExists{#1}%
    {\includegraphics{#1}}%
    {\fbox{\parbox{0.9\linewidth}{\centering\ttfamily Figure not generated yet:\\\detokenize{#1}}}}%
}

% \labresults{path}: load the macros written next to a fitted plot
% (e.g. figures/calibration.fit.tex) so the text can cite fitted values that update with the data.
\newcommand{\labresults}[1]{\InputIfFileExists{#1}{}{}}
